title: Uncovering the efficacy and mechanisms of Genkwa flos and bioactive ingredient genkwanin against L. monocytogenes infection.
authors: Xu, Lei; Lu, Gejin; Zhan, Baihe; Wei, Lijuan; Deng, Xuming; Zhang, Qiaoling; Shen, Xue; Wang, Jianfeng; Feng, Haihua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药芫花及其活性成分芫花素抗单核细胞增生李斯特菌感染的机制，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Genkwa flos (yuanhua in Chinese), the dried flower buds of the plant Daphne genkwa Siebold & Zucc., as a traditional herb widely used for the treatment of inflammation-related symptoms and diseases, with the efficacies of diuretic, phlegm-resolving and cough suppressant. AIM OF THE STUDY: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is presumed to be of immense potential against pathogens infection. Whereas, the potential efficacy and mechanisms of Genkwa flos against L. monocytogenes infection has not been extensively explored. The present study aimed to identify the bioactive ingredients of Genkwa flos against L. monocytogenes infection and to delineate the underlying mechanisms of action. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Bioinformatics approach at protein network level was employed to investigate the therapeutic mechanisms of Genkwa flos against L. monocytogenes infection. And hemolysis inhibition assay, cytoprotection test, western blotting, oligomerization assay and molecular docking analysis were applied to substantiate the multiple efficacies of Genkwa flos and the bioactive ingredient genkwanin. Histopathological analysis and biochemistry detection were conducted to evaluate the in vivo protective effect of genkwanin. RESULTS: Network pharmacology and experimental validation revealed that Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Genkwa flos exhibited anti-L. monocytogenes potency and was found to inhibit the hemolytic activity of LLO. Bioactive ingredient genkwanin interfered with the pore-forming activity of LLO by engaging the active residues Tyr414, Tyr98, Asn473, Val100, Tyr440 and Val438, and thereby attenuated LLO-mediated cytotoxicity. Consistent with the bioinformatics prediction, exposed to genkwanin could upregulate the Nrf2 level and promote the translocation of Nrf2. In vivo, genkwanin oral administration (80 mg/kg) significantly protected against systemic L. monocytogenes infection, as evidenced by reduced myeloperoxidase (MPO) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels, increased mice survival rate by 30% and decreased pathogen colonization. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrated that Genkwa flos is a potential anti-L. monocytogenes TCM, highlighted the therapeutic potential of Genkwa flos active ingredient genkwanin by targeting the pore-forming cytolysin LLO and acting as a promising antioxidative candidate against L. monocytogenes infection.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：芫花（中文称“yuanhua”），即瑞香科植物芫花（Daphne genkwa Siebold & Zucc.）的干燥花蕾，作为一种传统草药，广泛用于治疗炎症相关症状和疾病，具有利尿、化痰和止咳的功效。研究目的：传统中药（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）被认为在对抗病原体感染方面具有巨大潜力。然而，芫花对单核细胞增生李斯特菌（L. monocytogenes）感染的潜在功效和机制尚未被广泛探索。本研究旨在鉴定芫花抗L. monocytogenes感染的生物活性成分，并阐明其潜在作用机制。材料与方法：采用蛋白质网络水平的生物信息学方法研究芫花抗L. monocytogenes感染的治疗机制。并通过溶血抑制试验、细胞保护测试、western blotting、寡聚化分析和分子对接分析来验证芫花及其生物活性成分芫花素（genkwanin）的多重功效。进行组织病理学分析和生化检测以评估芫花素的体内保护作用。结果：网络药理学和实验验证表明，传统中药芫花表现出抗L. monocytogenes的效力，并发现其能抑制LLO的溶血活性。生物活性成分芫花素通过结合活性残基Tyr414、Tyr98、Asn473、Val100、Tyr440和Val438干扰LLO的孔形成活性，从而减轻LLO介导的细胞毒性。与生物信息学预测一致，暴露于芫花素可上调Nrf2水平并促进Nrf2的转位。在体内，芫花素口服给药（80 mg/kg）显著保护免受系统性L. monocytogenes感染，表现为髓过氧化物酶（MPO）和丙二醛（MDA）水平降低，小鼠存活率提高30%，病原体定植减少。结论：我们的研究表明，芫花是一种潜在抗L. monocytogenes的中药，强调了芫花活性成分芫花素通过靶向孔形成细胞溶素LLO的治疗潜力，并作为对抗L. monocytogenes感染的有前景的抗氧化候选药物。
